test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A takes 12 days to finish a job, while B takes 36 days to complete the same job. If they collaborate, how many days will it take them to complete the work together?
solution:
**Given:**

A takes 12 days to complete the job.

B takes 36 days to complete the job.

**Formula Used:**

Work done in 1 day = 1 ÷ Time taken to complete the job.

Total work = 1 (entire job).

Time taken when working together = 1 ÷ (Work done by A in 1 day + Work done by B in 1 day).

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done by A in 1 day = 1 ÷ 12 = 1/12.

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1 ÷ 36 = 1/36.

⇒ Total work done in 1 day when A and B work together = 1/12 + 1/36.

⇒ Total work done in 1 day = (3 + 1) ÷ 36 = 4 ÷ 36 = 1/9.

⇒ Time taken when working together = 1 ÷ (1/9) = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**
